title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining high-quality services consistently.
We achieve the mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Pricing Analyst , who will be responsible for maximizing spot market win rate and margin across client’s automated and manual pricing channels. This role monitors load boards on behalf of multiple customers, personally bids on exception freight that falls outside the parameters of automated pricing bot, and continuously evaluates bot performance to recommend rule and rate adjustments that improve coverage and competitiveness. The Pricing Analyst partners with carrier sales, operations, and technology teams to ensure pricing decisions are fast, accurate, and aligned with market conditions.
Responsibilities :
Load Board Monitoring & Spot Bidding

• Monitor load boards and bid portals in real time across an assigned portfolio of customers.

• Identify available spot freight opportunities and prioritize by margin potential, service risk, and customer importance.

• Submit competitive, timely bids and rate confirmations directly on loads within pricing authority.

•
Track win/loss outcomes and reasons (rate, timing, capacity, service) to inform pricing strategy.

Exception Freight Pricing

• dentify and price freight that cannot be bid automatically by the pricing bot due to non-standard lanes, equipment, service requirements, or market volatility.

• Apply market knowledge, historical rate data, and carrier capacity insight to price exception loads accurately and quickly.

• Escalate high-risk or high-value exceptions to leadership when pricing authority limits are reached.

•
Document pricing rationale for exception freight to support audit, margin review, and bot rule development.

Bot Optimization & Rule Tuning

•
Continuously evaluate automated bidding bot performance, including win rate, coverage, and margin by

lane and customer.

• Identify patterns in bot losses or missed opportunities and translate them into concrete rule, rate, or parameter change recommendations.

• Partner with technology and pricing leadership to test, validate, and implement bot rule updates.

•
Maintain documentation of bot logic changes and their measured impact on win rate and margin.

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting

• Analyze spot market trends, lane-level rate movement, and competitive pricing to inform bidding strategy.

• Maintain accurate records of bids, wins, losses, and exception pricing in CRM/pricing systems.

• Deliver regular reporting on win rate, coverage, and margin performance by customer, lane, and channel(bot vs. manual).

• Support forecasting of spot volume and pricing performance for leadership review.

Working conditions :

• Working schedule: Monday - Friday 08:00-17:00 EST

• Remote mode of work

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• Team building and corporate events

• Equipment provided

• A supportive team

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in freight brokerage pricing, carrier sales, or transportation analytics.

• Working knowledge of load boards (DAT, Truckstop, or similar) and spot market bidding dynamics.

• Comfort making fast, high-volume pricing decisions under time pressure.

• Analytical mindset; able to translate performance data into specific, actionable rule or rate changes.

• Familiarity with automated pricing/bidding tools or a strong aptitude for learning rule-based systems.

• Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint).

Highlights
Brokerage
Freight Pricing
Spot Bidding

title: Machine Learning Scientist/Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Science Teams

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member. MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world. You will help define and build the foundation-model learning stack for robotics: novel model architectures, pre-training objectives, post-training methods, and scalable data and training systems. The work combines frontier ML research with a direct route to real-world evaluation on a growing fleet of robots. Your work may span vision-language-action models, world and action models, video and multimodal models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and self-supervised learning. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets and distributed training infrastructure to develop increasingly capable, robust, and general robot policies. You will collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers, roboticists, and hardware teams to turn promising ideas into large-scale experiments, strong research contributions, and compelling robot demonstrations.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Design and run experiments on model architectures, learning objectives and data strategies for robot foundation models.

- Build scalable pre-training and post-training methods using web video, egocentric video and robot-interaction data.

- Curate, filter, mix and evaluate large robotics datasets, including egocentric, UMI and teleoperated data.

- Develop and use distributed training pipelines for large multimodal models and datasets.

- Partner with ML engineers, roboticists and hardware teams to turn research progress into measurable real-world robot performance.

- Communicate findings through rigorous internal reviews, publications and robot demonstrations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Research and develop model architectures, learning objectives, and data strategies for robot foundation models.

- Develop scalable self-supervised and generative pre-training methods using web video, egocentric video, and robot-interaction data.

- Develop post-training approaches, including supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and related methods, to improve real-world robot capabilities.

- Curate, filter, and evaluate large-scale robotics datasets, including egocentric, UMI, and teleoperated data.

- Build and use distributed training pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

- Work closely with robotics and hardware teams to connect model progress to measurable real-world performance.

- Communicate research clearly internally and, where appropriate, through publications and Wayve’s scientific presence.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- Experience in machine learning, with a focus on multimodal foundation models and data for foundation models.

- Experience with scalable training, such as multi-node training, large datasets and/or large model training.

- Strong research track record, including publications in top-tier venues such as ICRA, CoRL, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.

- Strong engineering skills and hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks.

- Ability to design and run rigorous experiments while collaborating closely with engineering and robotics teams.

- Experience translating research ideas into working systems, experiments or deployed capabi

title: Lead Training Captain
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB)  is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

In this role you will be responsible for developing and delivering comprehensive pilot training programs for KC-135 operations. This role ensures compliance with aviation regulations, oversees simulator and flight training, and mentors instructor pilots to maintain the highest standards of safety and proficiency.  In addition to these responsibilities, the position also serves as a Pilot-in-Command (PIC) of Metrea Strategic Mobility’s KC-135 tanker aircraft. In this capacity, the individual exercises final authority for the safe and compliant operation of assigned missions, leads flight crews through all phases of flight, and ensures strict adherence to FAA regulations, company policies, operational specifications, and contractual requirements. PIC responsibilities include mission planning and execution, sound aeronautical decision-making consistent with the SMS, and the completion of post-flight duties. The role requires maintaining all required qualifications, training, certifications, and currency, and performing additional flight-related duties as assigned.

title: Medical Science Liaison, West (Multiple Territories)

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's Next Gen Robotics team builds and integrates the robotic systems that power our development lab. As a contract Robotics Lab Technician, you will design, build, and integrate those systems, combining off-the-shelf components like robot arms, mobile bases, and sensors (cameras, lidars, and similar) into new configurations.

You will do real CAD design work, creating the mounts, fixtures, and adapters that let these components work together, then producing them through 3D printing and building them out by hand. You will also handle the electrical and controls work needed to wire everything up and get it running.

This is a practical, in-lab role for someone comfortable designing a solution and then getting hands-on with the robot.

What You'll Be Building

• Design parts, mounts, fixtures, and adapters in CAD to integrate off-the-shelf robotic components

• Take measurements, iterate on fit and function, and produce parts via 3D printing and light fabrication

• Assemble and integrate robotic hardware from your own designs or engineering drawings

• Wire and mount sensors, actuators, and control components, including cable routing and connector termination

• Configure motor controllers, I/O, and sensor interfaces, and debug basic control issues alongside engineers

• Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot robotics sensors and subsystems during bring-up and integration

• Maintain and upgrade lab robots, document builds and fixes, and keep the lab safe and organized

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Hands-on experience working on or around robots, such as arms or mobile bases, with a practical understanding of how they function

• Solid working ability in CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar), able to design parts from scratch

• Comfortable taking measurements, iterating on fit and function, and producing parts via 3D printing

• Familiarity with common robotics sensors (cameras, lidars, or similar), including installation, wiring, and basic troubleshooting

• Basic hands-on electrical skills: wiring, soldering or crimping, using a multimeter, reading simple schematics

• Practical, adaptable problem-solver who is comfortable in a fast-moving, hands-on lab environment

• Good communicator who can work closely with engineers across mechanical, electrical, and software domains

Bonus Points For

• Some exposure to controls hardware (motor controllers, I/O boards, actuators) and willingness to learn more

• Experience designing mounts, brackets, or adapters to integrate off-the-shelf hardware components

• Prior experience in a robotics lab, research lab, or similar hands-on hardware environment

• Familiarity with ROS or other robotics software or middleware

• Experience with 3D printers (setup, calibration, basic troubleshooting)

• Any background in mechatronics, electromechanical work, or a related technical field

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis
À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :
L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom
Missions

• Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

• Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

• Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

• Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités
1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel

• Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

• Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

• Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés ( Timed Automata ) et de machines à états finis temporisées ( Timed Finite State Machines ).

• Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

• Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation ( synchronizing sequences ), de détermination de l’état initial ( homing sequences ) et de distinction ( distinguishing sequences ).

• Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

• Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

• Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche

• Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

The Forensic Psychology PhD program. title: RevOps Manager
description:
About Improvado
Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.
We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.
About the role
Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.
What you will do
Salesforce and GTM stack

• Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

• Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.

• Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

• Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

• Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

• Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

• Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

• Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

• Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

• Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

• Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

• Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

• Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.
Requirements

• 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.

• Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.

• Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

• Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

• Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

• Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

• Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

• ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

• Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).

• Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

• Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

• HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

• Attribution or CS health score data.

• Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

• Remote-first environment

• Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises

• 20 working days of PTO per year

• US holidays and additional days off

• Professional development reimbursement

title: Talent Sourcer
description:
Robots & Pencils is seeking an English-speaking Contract Sourcer & Recruiting Coordinator based in LATAM to support our global recruiting team. This is a blended talent operations role combining candidate sourcing and recruiting coordination across multiple active searches. You will partner closely with recruiters to identify candidates, manage pipelines, and ensure interviews run smoothly across international time zones.
This is an execution-focused, high-volume recruiting support role. You will proactively source candidates for technical and delivery positions, conduct outreach, and track sourcing activity while also coordinating interviews, managing calendars, and maintaining a consistent and professional candidate experience. You will collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers to keep hiring processes organized, efficient, and on schedule.
In this role, you are expected to operate with reliability, urgency, and attention to detail. You will manage competing priorities, maintain accurate tracking documentation, and help reduce recruiting friction by ensuring scheduling, communication, and follow-through are handled consistently and professionally.
This is a blended role:

• ~50% sourcing support across global searches

• ~30-50% interview scheduling and recruiting coordination

The environment is high volume and deadline-driven. We need someone who thrives in pace, structure, and clear execution.
Key Responsibilities
Sourcing (Approx. 50%)

• Partner with Recruiters to understand role requirements and timelines

• Source candidates globally across technical and delivery roles

• Conduct proactive outreach and manage candidate pipelines

• Track sourcing metrics

Recruiting Coordination (Approx. 30-50%)

• Schedule interviews across multiple time zones

• Coordinate calendars with candidates and internal interviewers

• Send confirmations and ensure a smooth candidate experience

• Maintain interview tracking and documentation

• Support offer logistics and administrative follow-through

Qualifications

• 2+ years of sourcing, recruiting coordination, or talent operations experience

• Fluent English (written and spoken)

• Experience scheduling across global time zones

• Comfortable in high-volume environments

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Reliable internet connection and ability to work within global business hours as needed

What We’re Looking For

• Calm under pressure

• Strong sense of urgency

• Clear communicator

• Process-oriented and highly dependable

This is a 3-month contractor engagement with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role depending on business needs and performance.
Why Join Robots & Pencils?
We run recruiting operations that support real delivery teams, real clients, and real deadlines.
As a Contract Sourcer & Recruiting Coordinator, you will play a key role in enabling our hiring processes to scale effectively. You’ll work directly with a global recruiting team, gain exposure to international hiring practices, and contribute to the growth of teams across multiple disciplines.
This is a role for organized, proactive professionals who enjoy structured work, fast pace, and clear execution and who want hands-on experience supporting global talent acquisition operations with meaningful impact.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you!

You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs-from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will:

- Build and refine marketing operational frameworks - Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes.

- Own account intelligence and reporting cadence - Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic.

- Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops - Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team.

- Ensure tooling health and systems ownership - Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements.

- Enable team capabilities and documentation habits - Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- HubSpot Fluency - A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform.

- Account Operations Mindset - Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation ado

title: Senior Security & Compliance - Healthcare | Zenara Health
description:
Location: Remote - India
Type: Full-time
Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST , overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.
Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week
Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory
About the Company
Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive patient data, so security, access control, vendor risk, AI-tool risk, and evidence of how our controls operate are fundamental to earning customer trust.
We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly and need a security and compliance program that is rigorous enough for healthcare and practical enough to work in a small, fast-moving company.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Security & Compliance Lead to build and own Zenara’s security and compliance program.
You will set risk priorities, define security and HIPAA-related controls, verify that they work, and lead our responses to customer security reviews. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and our Platform Engineer, who owns day-to-day platform operations and implements and operates many of the technical controls.
You own the program’s direction and outcomes. The Platform Engineer owns the day-to-day operation of the platform. You will work together to turn security requirements into working practices, not just documents.
Here is the test: can you inspect a real technical environment, identify the risks that matter most, explain the trade-offs, and work with engineers to implement and verify effective controls?
We are not looking for someone who only produces compliance paperwork. We need a leader with healthcare security judgment, technical depth, and the willingness to remain involved until a control actually works.
Our Security and Compliance Vision
Security and compliance should be part of how Zenara operates every day-not a last-minute exercise when a customer sends a questionnaire.
You will build a program with clear control owners, practical policies, current evidence, tracked remediation, and tested response procedures. It should give engineering a safe path to move quickly while helping us protect patient data and answer customer questions with confidence.
Your remit includes:

• HIPAA-related safeguards, policies, and evidence

• Security risk assessment and remediation priorities

• Technical control standards and verification

• Patient-data flows and access controls

• Vendor and AI-tool risk

• Customer security reviews and audit preparation

• Incident response and escalation procedures

• Security practices for AI-assisted engineering

The goal is not to create the largest possible program. It is to establish the right controls, make ownership clear, and ensure those controls keep working as Zenara grows.
What You’ll Do

• Own the security and compliance roadmap, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and follow-through.

• Establish and maintain HIPAA-related policies, procedures, control requirements, and supporting evidence.

• Review cloud infrastructure, access controls, secrets management, and other technical safeguards with the Platform Engineer.

• Define what technical controls must achieve; partner with the Platform Engineer to implement and operate them; independently verify their effectiveness.

• Review patient-data flows, vendors, AI tools, and LLM-related data risks.

• Set requirements for how AI agents and tools access data, systems, and production environments.

• Lead responses to customer security questionnaires and coordinate preparation for audits or other external reviews.

• Establish incident response and escalation procedures, and help coordinate the response to significant security events.

• Review the Platform Engineer’s security work regularly, mentor
